metadata.title: Legendre manifolds generated by the Barenblatt equations
metadata.abstract: The paper is devoted to the construction of exact general solutions of the equations of oil filtration in a porous medium under the action of an active reagent injected into the reservoir. The choice of the reagent solution determines the control process of chemical oil flooding in hard-to-recover fields. The problem is described by a system of two first-order nonlinear partial differential equations (the Barenblatt model). Conditions are found on the Buckley--Leverett function, the adsorption function, and the distribution function of the reagent in oil under which the original system, by means of a nonlinear change of variables on a five-dimensional manifold endowed with a contact structure, is reduced to a linear wave system with constant coefficients. Six families of such functions are indicated. For them, contact transformations and Legendre surfaces corresponding to general solutions in implicit form are constructed.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Barenblatt方程的接触线性化与Legendre曲面
analysis.workSummary: 对化学驱油Barenblatt两条一阶非线性PDE，在Buckley–Leverett、吸附及试剂分布函数满足特定条件时，通过五维接触流形上的非线性换元化为常系数线性波系统。给六类函数、对应接触变换及表示隐式通解的Legendre曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 为指定非线性系数组提供可显式接触变换的通解表达。
analysis.limitations: 只限列出的系数条件/函数族，隐式局部通解不等于任意系数或边界初值问题的全局适定性。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际PDF SHA-256与本次记录一致；共13页，页数一致、文本完整提取、无短文本页。标准与点写A.I./A. I.、断行/连字符模型名称（含Danus）和AI用语补检未观察到作者自身使用披露；无披露不等同未使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 接触几何在连续介质模型中的应用，几何分析优先级较低。
